SELECT sf.sf_num AS sfNum, sf.sf_portion AS sfPortion, sf.fo_num AS foNum, sf.user_num AS userNum,
f.fo_name AS foName, f.fo_base_gram AS foBaseGram, f.fo_kcal AS foKcal, f.fo_carbs AS foCarbs, f.fo_protein AS foProtein, f.fo_fat AS foFat, f.fo_natrium AS foNatrium, f.fo_type AS foType
FROM singlefood_favorites sf JOIN food f ON sf.fo_num = f.fo_num
WHERE sf.user_num = #{userNum}
ORDER BY sf.sf_num DESC
